subject: social_studies
concept: Understanding local versus global goods: some things a community makes itself, other things come from far away
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.pictorial: Student traces a common item back to where it might have been made, local or far away
exercise.abstract: Student explains why some things a community uses come from far away rather than being made locally

misconception_flags: believes everything a community uses is always made within that same community

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
